items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: Johnny Hodges where are you? Well you know that’s Cannon

ctx.x: Johnny Hodges where are you? Well you know that’s Cannon — “Stars Fell on Alabama” and he had done that on the Riverside, you know the studio version, but I had heard him do that in a club and when I got these tapes from Allen Grant I listened and I said, oh man, Cannon playing “Stars Fell on Alabama.” You hear what he plays? That’s why them called him the new Bird for that first year. I heard some Bird the other day you’ve never heard. It’s spectacular. A guy’s apartment in 1950.
